note: Ingredients and amounts as published by the IBA (units normalised; 'Old Cuban' and 'South Side' mint counts read as ranges; IBA Tiki's unitless pineapple/lime read as ml). Methods paraphrased. Drinks already in the Difford's Top 100 (Mai-Tai, Zombie, Jungle Bird, Missionary's Downfall, Three Dots and a Dash, Suffering Bastard) are not repeated.

cocktails.name: Alexander
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything hard with ice, then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Americano
cocktails.garnish: Half orange slice and a lemon zest
cocktails.methodSummary: Build the Campari and vermouth over ice in an old fashioned glass, finish with a splash of soda and give it a gentle stir.

cocktails.name: Angel Face
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Aviation
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake all ingredients with cracked ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Bee's Knees
cocktails.methodSummary: Dissolve the honey into the citrus juices, add the gin, shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Bellini
cocktails.methodSummary: Add peach purée to an iced mixing glass, top with Prosecco, stir gently and pour into a chilled flute.

cocktails.name: Between the Sheets
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Black Russian
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in an old fashioned glass and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Bloody Mary
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir everything gently with ice in a mixing glass and pour into a rocks glass (or a highball over ice if requested).

cocktails.name: Boulevardier
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Bramble
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything except the crème de mûre with ice, strain over crushed ice in a chilled old fashioned glass, then drizzle the blackberry liqueur over the top in a circle.

cocktails.name: Brandy Crusta
cocktails.garnish: Sugar-crusted rim (orange or lemon rubbed) and a long orange/lemon peel curled inside the glass
cocktails.methodSummary: Mix with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a slim cocktail glass prepared with a sugar crust and citrus peel.

cocktails.name: Caipirinha
cocktails.methodSummary: Gently muddle lime and sugar in a double old fashioned glass, fill with cracked ice, add cachaça and stir.

cocktails.name: Canchanchara
cocktails.methodSummary: Mix honey, water and lime and coat the inside of the glass with it; add cracked ice and the spirit, then stir vigorously from the bottom up.

cocktails.name: Cardinale
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Casino
cocktails.garnish: Lemon zest and a maraschino cherry
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled rocks glass over ice.

cocktails.name: Champagne Cocktail
cocktails.methodSummary: Put a bitters-soaked sugar cube in a large champagne glass, add the cognac and gently top with chilled champagne.

cocktails.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
cocktails.methodSummary: Build in a tall glass over pebble ice, swizzle hard, then top up with more pebble ice.

cocktails.name: Clover Club
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Corpse Reviver #2
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Cosmopolitan
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a large cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Cuba Libre
cocktails.methodSummary: Build everything over ice in a highball glass.

cocktails.name: Daiquiri
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir the ingredients in the shaker until the sugar dissolves, then add ice, shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Dark 'N' Stormy
cocktails.methodSummary: Pour ginger beer over ice in a highball glass and float the rum on top.

cocktails.name: Don's Special Daiquiri
cocktails.methodSummary: Flash-blend briefly with crushed ice, pour into a footed copo glass and top with more crushed ice.

cocktails.name: Dry Martini
cocktails.garnish: Lemon peel oils, or green olive on request
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled martini glass.

cocktails.name: Espresso Martini
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake hard with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Fernandito
cocktails.methodSummary: Pour Fernet over ice in a double old fashioned glass, fill with cola and stir gently.

cocktails.name: French 75
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything but the Champagne, strain into a flute, top with Champagne and stir gently.

cocktails.name: French Connection
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in an old fashioned glass and stir gently.

cocktails.name: French Martini
cocktails.garnish: Lemon peel oils expressed over the drink
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Garibaldi
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in a highball glass.

cocktails.name: Gin Basil Smash
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything hard with ice and pour into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Gin Fizz
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything except the soda with ice, pour into a thin tall tumbler and top with a splash of soda; served without ice.

cocktails.name: Grand Margarita
cocktails.methodSummary: Salt-rim a rocks glass and fill with ice; shake the ingredients hard for about 10 seconds and strain into the glass.

cocktails.name: Grasshopper
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake briskly with ice for a few seconds and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Hanky Panky
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Hemingway Special
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a large cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Horse's Neck
cocktails.methodSummary: Build cognac and ginger ale over ice in a highball glass, stir gently, and add bitters if desired.

cocktails.name: IBA Tiki
cocktails.garnish: Citrus and a dehydrated pineapple slice
cocktails.methodSummary: Muddle a thin ginger slice in the shaker, add everything else, shake hard with ice and strain into a chilled tiki glass over pebble ice. IBA gives the pineapple and lime without a unit; ml is assumed, like the rest of the recipe.

cocktails.name: Illegal
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake hard with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass, or serve on the rocks in a clay/terracotta mug.

cocktails.name: Irish Coffee
cocktails.methodSummary: Pour hot coffee into a warmed Irish coffee glass, stir in whiskey and sugar until dissolved, then float chilled cream over the back of a spoon so it sits on top.

cocktails.name: John Collins
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in a highball and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Kir
cocktails.methodSummary: Add crème de cassis to the glass and top with white wine.

cocktails.name: Last Word
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Lemon Drop Martini
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Long Island Iced Tea
cocktails.methodSummary: Build everything in an ice-filled highball glass and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Manhattan
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Margarita
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Martinez
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Mary Pickford
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Mimosa
cocktails.methodSummary: Pour orange juice into a flute, gently add the sparkling wine and stir lightly.

cocktails.name: Mint Julep
cocktails.methodSummary: Lightly muddle mint, sugar and water in a julep cup, pack with cracked ice, add bourbon and stir until the cup frosts.

cocktails.name: Mojito
cocktails.garnish: Mint sprigs and a lime slice
cocktails.methodSummary: Muddle mint with sugar and lime, add a splash of soda, fill with ice, add rum and top with soda; stir lightly.

cocktails.name: Monkey Gland
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Moscow Mule
cocktails.methodSummary: Combine vodka and ginger beer in a mule cup or rocks glass, add lime juice and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Naked and Famous
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Negroni
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in a chilled old fashioned glass and stir gently.

cocktails.name: New York Sour
cocktails.garnish: Lemon or orange zest with a cherry
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake hard with ice, strain over fresh ice in a chilled rocks glass, then float the red wine on top.

cocktails.name: Old Cuban
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything except the sparkling wine with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass and top with the wine.

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.garnish: Orange slice or zest and a cocktail cherry
cocktails.methodSummary: Soak a sugar cube with bitters and a little water in the glass and muddle to dissolve; add ice and whiskey and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Paloma
cocktails.methodSummary: Pour tequila into a highball, squeeze in the lime, add ice and a pinch of salt, top with pink grapefruit soda and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Paper Plane
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Paradise
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Penicillin
cocktails.methodSummary: Muddle ginger in the shaker, add everything except the Islay malt, shake with ice, fine strain over ice in a chilled old fashioned glass and float the Islay whisky on top.

cocktails.name: Pina Colada
cocktails.garnish: Pineapple slice with a cocktail cherry
cocktails.methodSummary: Blend with ice, pour into a large glass and serve with straws.

cocktails.name: Pisco Punch
cocktails.methodSummary: Gently mash cloves in the syrup, add everything but the wine, shake hard, double strain into a large goblet, then add the wine and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Pisco Sour
cocktails.garnish: A few dashes of Amargo bitters on top
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled goblet.

cocktails.name: Planters Punch
cocktails.methodSummary: Build directly in a small tumbler or traditional terracotta cup; dilute to taste with water, ice or fresh juices.

cocktails.name: Porn Star Martini

ingredients.ingredient: Champagne to serve on the side

cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice, double strain into a large chilled cocktail glass and serve with a shot of Champagne alongside.

cocktails.name: Porto Flip
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Rabo de Galo
cocktails.methodSummary: Combine in a rocks glass, add ice and stir briefly.

cocktails.name: Ramos Fizz
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything but soda with ice for about two minutes, strain, dry-shake hard for another minute, strain into a highball and top with soda.

cocktails.name: Remember the Maine
cocktails.methodSummary: Rinse a coupe with absinthe and discard it; stir the remaining ingredients with ice and strain into the rinsed glass.

cocktails.name: Russian Spring Punch
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake everything except the sparkling wine with ice, strain into an ice-filled tall tumbler and top with sparkling wine.

cocktails.name: Rusty Nail
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in an old fashioned glass and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Sazerac
cocktails.methodSummary: Rinse a chilled old fashioned glass with absinthe over crushed ice; stir the rest with ice, empty the prepared glass and strain the drink into it.

cocktails.name: Sea Breeze
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in a highball glass.

cocktails.name: Sex on the Beach
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in a highball glass.

cocktails.name: Sherry Cobbler
cocktails.garnish: Fresh berries plus a quarter wheel each of orange and lemon; serve with straws
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake the sherries, sugar and quarter wheels of orange and lemon briskly with ice, then strain into a julep cup packed with crushed ice.

cocktails.name: Sidecar
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Singapore Sling
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a hurricane glass.

cocktails.name: South Side
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice (vigorously if using egg white) and double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Spicy Fifty
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Spritz
cocktails.methodSummary: Build over ice in a wine glass and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Stinger
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled martini glass.

cocktails.name: Tequila Sunrise
cocktails.garnish: Half orange slice or orange zest
cocktails.methodSummary: Build tequila and orange juice over ice in a highball, then add grenadine so it sinks for the sunrise effect; do not stir.

cocktails.name: Tipperary
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled martini glass.

cocktails.name: Tommy's Margarita
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into an ice-filled chilled rocks glass.

cocktails.name: Trinidad Sour
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Tuxedo
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled martini glass.

cocktails.name: Ve.N.To
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake hard with ice and strain over ice into a chilled small tumbler. IBA's honey mix is honey loosened with water (the water can be swapped for chamomile tea).

cocktails.name: Vesper
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Vieux Carré
cocktails.methodSummary: Stir well with ice in a mixing glass and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktails.name: Whiskey Sour
cocktails.garnish: Half orange slice and maraschino cherry, optionally orange zest
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice (harder if using egg white) and strain into a cobbler glass, or over ice in an old fashioned glass for on the rocks.

cocktails.name: White Lady
cocktails.methodSummary: Shake well with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
